summary: TuHURA Biosciences filed an 8-K/A amending prior pro forma financial statements related to its June 2025 acquisition of Kineta. The filing corrects errors in the unaudited pro forma condensed combined statement of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025. No new terms, prices, premiums, or dates are provided. The merger was completed nearly a year prior, and this amendment solely revises previously filed pro forma disclosures. There is no active deal, recommendation, or risk-arb angle; the filing is a routine correction of historical financial information.
